title: Sz Kyung Yuin

page_data.en:
C. I. B.
I. O. D.
No. 446
Date 13/7/16

Shanghai Municipal Council.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)

July 13th 1916

Sir,
One hundred and twenty soldiers returned to
Lunghwa from Sungkiang on 12th instant.

A high official named Sz Kyung Yuin 師景雲 is
expected to arrive in Shanghai soon to make arrangements
to have the troops here transferred to the north.

It is rumoured that Ho Hai King 何海鳴 is in
Shanghai and is staying in the western part of Frenchtown.

On his arrival here, Huang Hsing was expecting that
President Li Yuen Hung would request his advice on
state affairs. This request has not been made, and
in consequence Huang Hsing feels very bitter towards
the President.

Your Obedient Servant,

（签名）

Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

（签名）

（左侧批注：AE / Cm / AM）
page_data.zh:
C. I. B.
I. O. D.
第 446 号
日期 1916年7月13日

上海工部局。

（印：上海工部局警务处）
警务处，
（侦探股）

1916年7月13日

先生：

一百二十名士兵于本月12日从松江返回龙华。

一位名为师景云的高级官员预计不久将抵达上海，安排将驻此地的部队调往北方。

有谣言称何海鸣在上海，并正住在法租界西部。

黄兴抵沪时，曾期望黎元洪总统就国事征询其意见。但此请求并未提出，因此黄兴对总统深感不满。

您顺从的仆人，

（签名）

总探长。

警务处总监。

（签名）

（左侧批注：AE / Cm / AM）
